seo.title: Ministries and movements
seo.description: Discover the ministries and movements of Saint Anthony of Padua Parish in Dois Vizinhos and find where you can serve.

hero.title: {{count}} ways to serve.
hero.lead: Everyone has a gift to place at the service of the community. Meet the groups that make the parish happen.

liturgy.title: Liturgy and prayer
liturgy.description: Those who serve at the altar and sustain the community through prayer.

formation.title: Formation and youth
formation.description: Those who teach, form and accompany the new generations.

family.title: Family
family.description: Those who care for the domestic Church, in homes and households.

charity.title: Social action and charity
charity.description: Those who carry the faith wherever there is need.

movements.title: Movements
movements.description: Spiritual paths that renew Christian life.

liturgy.title: Liturgy
liturgy.description: Prepares and leads the celebrations: readings, prayers, welcome and care for every detail of the altar.

music.title: Music
music.description: Music ministries that help the assembly pray through song at Masses and celebrations.

altar-servers.title: Altar servers
altar-servers.description: Children and teenagers who serve at the altar and learn, up close, to love the Eucharist.

extraordinary-ministers.title: Communion ministers (MACs)
extraordinary-ministers.description: Lay people who help distribute Communion at Mass and bring it to the sick and elderly at home.

apostleship-of-prayer.title: Apostleship of Prayer
apostleship-of-prayer.description: A prayer network devoted to the Sacred Heart of Jesus, praying for the intentions of the Pope and the Church.

catechesis.title: Catechesis
catechesis.description: Accompanies children, young people and adults in Christian initiation, toward First Communion and Confirmation.

youth.title: Teens and youth
youth.description: Two groups energize the parish youth: RAJOV, for teenagers, and Opção de Vida, for young adults.

youth-retreat.title: Teen and youth retreat
youth-retreat.description: Weekend gatherings that help teens and young people live a personal experience with Christ.

pastoral-council.title: Pastoral council
pastoral-council.description: Brings together leaders of communities and ministries to plan and review the parish's journey.

family.title: Family ministry
family.description: Cares for families at every stage: marriage preparation, couples, parents and difficult situations.

family-groups.title: Family groups
family-groups.description: Neighboring families who meet in their homes to pray and reflect on the Word of God.

pilgrim-chapel.title: Pilgrim chapel
pilgrim-chapel.description: An image of Our Lady visits homes, bringing prayer and unity to families.

children.title: Children's ministry
children.description: Supports pregnant women and young children, focusing on health, nutrition and care at home.

elderly.title: Ministry to the elderly
elderly.description: Visits and values older people, promoting their dignity, health and participation in the community.

prison.title: Prison ministry
prison.description: The Church's presence among people deprived of liberty and their families, through listening and evangelization.

tithe.title: Tithe ministry
tithe.description: Helps the community live the tithe as a gesture of gratitude and sharing that sustains the mission.

charismatic-renewal.title: Charismatic Renewal
charismatic-renewal.description: Prayer groups seeking new life in the Holy Spirit through praise, the Word and sharing.

cursillo.title: Cursillo movement
cursillo.description: Gatherings that form lay Christians to live and proclaim their faith at work, at home and in society.

lareira.title: Lareira movement
lareira.description: A couples' movement that strengthens married and family life in the light of the Gospel.

legion-of-mary.title: Legion of Mary
legion-of-mary.description: Lay people who, under Mary's protection, pray together and carry out visits and works of apostolate.

join.title: Would you like to join a ministry?
join.description: Message the parish office and tell us what moves your heart. We'll put you in touch with the coordinators.
join.whatsappMessage: Hello! I'd like to join one of the parish ministries.
